name: Luveria
source:
A female swordswoman who is an officer of the Demon Lord's army.
She was once a princess of a country destroyed by monsters, but she fell into darkness under the influence of the Demon Lord's power and is now forced to serve as his subordinate.
She is outstanding not only as a warrior but also in leadership.
Calm, composed, cool, and refined. She hates anything wasteful or vulgar.
